description: Same retained save actor 0, original isolated startup. Native active-character Anvil outputs; no shared character switch. Anvil core outputs for the selected saved character. Native getters use active-character state. Cost totals replay the captured purchase formulas at the current native discount; they are not historical transaction totals. Source: docs/game-snippets/anvil/AnvilProduceStats.1.25.js and the focused source excerpts cited in the Anvil handoff.
target: Anvil per-character production speed, EXP bonus, capacity, Acme points, and reconstructed point purchase totals

extractions.label: anvil_actor_context
extractions.expression: (async()=>{const get=name=>idleon.getAttr(name);const decode=value=>typeof value==='string'?JSON.parse(value):value;const save=await(await fetch('/cloud-save')).json();const status=await(await fetch('/status')).json();const names=get('GetPlayersUsernames');const index=names.indexOf(get('UserInfo')[0]);const equal=(a,b,label)=>{if(JSON.stringify(a)!==JSON.stringify(b))throw Error('Unpaired Anvil context: '+label);};const levels=Array.from(get('Lv0'),Number);const talents=Object.fromEntries(Array.from(get('SkillLevels'),Number).flatMap((value,id)=>value!==0?[[String(id),value]]:[]));const savedTalents=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(decode(save[`SL_${index}`])).filter(([,value])=>Number(value)!==0).map(([id,value])=>[id,Number(value)]));equal(talents,savedTalents,'raw talents');const activeTalentPreset=get('PlayerStuff')[1];const divinityLinks=get('Divinity').slice(0,24);const superTalentMembership=get('Spelunk').slice(20,44);const labPositions=get('Lab')[0];const beanstalkQuantities=get('Ninja')[104];const foodIdentities=Array.from(get('EquipmentOrder')[2]);const foodSlotsOwned=Number(get('FoodSlotsOwned'));const materialBag=Number(get('MaxCarryCap').h.bCraft);equal(activeTalentPreset,decode(save[`PlayerStuff_${index}`])[1],'preset');equal(divinityLinks,save.Divinity.slice(0,24),'Divinity links');equal(superTalentMembership,decode(save.Spelunk).slice(20,44),'Super Talents');equal(labPositions,decode(save.Lab)[0],'Lab positions');equal(beanstalkQuantities,decode(save.Ninja)[104],'beanstalk');equal(foodIdentities,Array.from(decode(save[`EquipOrder_${index}`])[2]),'food identities');equal(foodSlotsOwned,Number(save[`FoodSlO_${index}`]),'food slots');equal(materialBag,Number(decode(save[`MaxCarryCap_${index}`]).bCraft),'material bag');const goldenFoodQuantities=[];for(let slot=0;slot<foodSlotsOwned;slot++){const item=foodIdentities[slot];if(item!=='Blank'&&get('ItemDefinitionsGET').h[item].h.Type==='GOLDEN_FOOD'){const quantity=Number(get('EquipmentQuantity')[2][slot]);equal(quantity,Number(decode(save[`EquipQTY_${index}`])[2][slot]),'golden food quantity '+slot);goldenFoodQuantities.push({slot,item,quantity});}}const accountTalentAllocations=names.map((playerName,actorIndex)=>{const allocated={};for(const id of [49,54,56,209,535,536]){allocated[id]=Number(get('PlayerDATABASE').h[playerName].h.SkillLevels[id]);equal(allocated[id],Number(decode(save[`SL_${actorIndex}`])[id]||0),'account talent '+actorIndex+':'+id);}return{actorIndex,playerName,talents:allocated};});const canonical=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.map(canonical):value&&typeof value==='object'?Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(value).sort().map(key=>[key,canonical(value[key])])):value;const digest=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(canonical(save))));return{activePlayerIndex:index,playerName:get('UserInfo')[0],characterClass:get('CharacterClass'),mapId:get('CurrentMap'),smithingLevel:Number(levels[2]),pointCounts:Array.from(get('AnvilPAstats'),Number),acmeAllocatedLevel:Number(get('SkillLevels')[281]),acmeNativeBonus:idleon.callFunction('GetTalentNumber',1,281),levels,levelDriftIndexes:levels.flatMap((value,id)=>value===save[`Lv0_${index}`][id]?[]:[id]),talents,activeTalentPreset,divinityLinks,superTalentMembership,labPositions,beanstalkQuantities,foodIdentities,foodSlotsOwned,goldenFoodQuantities,materialBag,accountTalentAllocations,inputOptions:{zeroCharacterAfk:status.zeroCharacterAfk,evaluationTimeMs:status.evaluationTimeMs},effectiveInputCanonicalJsonSha256:Array.from(new Uint8Array(digest),value=>value.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')};})()
extractions.description: Native active actor identity, class, Smithing, point counts, Acme allocation and native talent bonus. Pair with retained startup save and canonical input hash in the actor-capture handoff.

extractions.label: anvil_production_speed_per_second
extractions.description: Native production work per second. The public anvilSpeed uses work per hour, so compare with 3600 times this capture.

extractions.label: anvil_production_exp_multiplier
extractions.description: Native production EXP multiplier after its soft cap. The public anvilXP is a bonus percentage: 100 times (multiplier minus 1).

extractions.label: anvil_product_capacity
extractions.description: Native per-product storage capacity, including the two-billion item limit.

extractions.label: anvil_acme_points
extractions.description: Native Acme point contribution for this actor, using active talent allocation and original final talent bonus.

extractions.label: anvil_saved_point_counts
extractions.description: Comparison context for the native cost replays and character selection. Match the retained save before comparing cost totals.

extractions.label: anvil_reconstructed_coin_spend
extractions.description: Sum of purchased coin-point prices at the current native character discount. This replays Costs1 without changing the purchased-point counter.

extractions.label: anvil_reconstructed_material_spend
extractions.expression: (()=>{const count=Number(idleon.getAttr('AnvilPAstats')[2]);const factor=Math.max(.1,1-Number(idleon.getAttr('DNSM').h.AlchBubbles.h.AnvilProdCost)/100);const tiers=[[5,'Grasslands1'],[15,'Grasslands2'],[25,'Grasslands3'],[40,'Jungle1'],[55,'Jungle3'],[70,'Forest1'],[85,'Forest3'],[100,'DesertA1'],[115,'DesertA3'],[130,'DesertB1'],[150,'DesertB3'],[175,'DesertC1'],[200,'DesertC2'],[225,'DesertC4'],[250,'SnowA2'],[280,'SnowB1'],[310,'SnowB3'],[350,'SnowC1'],[375,'SnowA4'],[410,'GalaxyA1'],[440,'GalaxyA3'],[470,'GalaxyA4'],[500,'GalaxyB1'],[540,'GalaxyB3'],[600,'GalaxyC1'],[700,'GalaxyC4']];const totals={};for(let point=0;point<count;point++){const tier=tiers.find(([limit])=>point<limit);if(!tier)throw Error('Purchased material-point count exceeds native limit');const item=tier[1];totals[item]=(totals[item]??0)+Math.round((Math.pow(point+1,1.5)+point)*factor);}return totals;})()
extractions.description: Purchased material-point prices grouped by native material identity, across every completed and partial tier. This replays Costs2 and Costs2TypeAnvilPA without mutating character state. Static threshold literals belong only to this independent native-source replay, not the domain implementation.
